title: Intermediate fields in a finite field extension are finite on both sides
statement: Let $K\subseteq E\subseteq L$ be fields [def-pc-field-extension]. If $L/K$ is finite, meaning finite-dimensional as a $K$-vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], then $E/K$ and $L/E$ are finite: $E$ is a finite-dimensional $K$-vector space and $L$ is a finite-dimensional $E$-vector space.
